en.headline: Local ice-cream brand TeemTonefai opens first permanent shop in Sheung Wan
en.dek: The 10-year-old maker of Chinese-ingredient flavours begins soft opening on 21 August at Upper Lascar Row, after years of pop-ups and collaborations.
body: Hong Kong ice-cream brand TeemTonefai is to open its first permanent retail outlet in Sheung Wan on 21 August, marking a decade of operation that began with pop-ups and market stalls.

The shop at 19 Upper Lascar Row will sell cups of ice cream and sorbet priced from about HK$50, featuring flavours that draw on Chinese tea, spices and local ingredients such as white peach oolong, sea salt with green Sichuan pepper, red date and purple rice, and ginger tofu pudding. The founders said the interior mixes 1980s Hong Kong industrial and colonial references.

Soft-opening promotions include a limited special-edition spoon for the first 50 paying customers on 21 and 22 August, and a buy-10-get-2 offer on ice-cream vouchers or box sets until the end of the month. Opening hours are listed as noon to 7 pm from 21 August.

zh.headline: 本地雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai上環開首間實體店
zh.dek: 成立十年的創意雪糕品牌8月21日起於上環摩羅上街試業，主打中式茶香及香料口味，過往以期間限定店及聯乘聞名。
body: 本地雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai（甜筒暉）將於8月21日在上環摩羅上街19號地下開設首間實體店，標誌品牌成立十年後由市集及期間限定店轉為常設零售點。
店內售賣約50元起的雪糕及雪葩杯，口味包括荔枝碧螺春、海鹽青花椒、紅棗紫米及薑汁豆腐花等，融合中式茗茶、辛香料及本地食材。創辦人表示店內裝潢糅合八十年代香港工業、殖民地及辦公元素。
試業期間，8月21及22日首50名消費顧客可獲特別版雪糕匙，另8月31日前購買雪糕券或十杯裝可享買十送二優惠。營業時間為中午12時至晚上7時。
